operation.name: CreateGBVDetail
operation.query:
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT GBVMainID FROM [GBVMain] WHERE Deleted = 0 AND GBVMainID =@GBVMainID )) SET @ReturnValue = 0 ELSE BEGIN INSERT INTO [dbo].[GBVDetails] ([GBVMainID] ,[ReportedToManagementHR] ,[ReportedDetails] ,[FollowUpActionFeedback] ,[IsSurvivorSatisfied] ,[SurvivorDetails] ,[ClosingDateAfterManagementAction] ,[CreationUserID] ,[Deleted]) VALUES (@GBVMainID ,@ReportedToManagementHR ,@ReportedDetails ,@FollowUpActionFeedback ,@IsSurvivorSatisfied ,@SurvivorDetails ,@ClosingDateAfterManagementAction ,@CreationUserID ,0)
SET @ReturnValue = SCOPE_IDENTITY() END

operation.name: UpdateGBVDetail
operation.query:
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT GBVMainID FROM [GBVDetails] WHERE Deleted = 0 AND GBVDetailID = @GBVDetailID )) SET @ReturnValue = 0 ELSE BEGIN
UPDATE [dbo].[GBVDetails] SET [ReportedToManagementHR] = @ReportedToManagementHR ,[ReportedDetails] = @ReportedDetails ,[FollowUpActionFeedback] = @FollowUpActionFeedback ,[IsSurvivorSatisfied] = @IsSurvivorSatisfied ,[SurvivorDetails] = @SurvivorDetails ,[ClosingDateAfterManagementAction] = @ClosingDateAfterManagementAction ,[LastModificationTimestamp] = @LastModificationTimestamp ,[LastModificationUserID] = @LastModificationUserID
WHERE Deleted = 0 and GBVDetailID = @GBVDetailID
SET @ReturnValue = 1
END

operation.name: GetGBVDetails
operation.query:
SELECT [GBVDetailID] ,[GBVMainID] ,[ReportedToManagementHR] ,[ReportedDetails] ,[FollowUpActionFeedback] ,[IsSurvivorSatisfied] ,[SurvivorDetails] ,[ClosingDateAfterManagementAction] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID]
FROM [GBVDetails] WHERE DELETED = 0 AND GBVMainID = @GBVMainID ORDER BY GBVDetailID ASC

operation.name: GetGBVDetail
operation.query:
SELECT [GBVDetailID] ,[GBVMainID] ,[ReportedToManagementHR] ,[ReportedDetails] ,[FollowUpActionFeedback] ,[IsSurvivorSatisfied] ,[SurvivorDetails] ,[ClosingDateAfterManagementAction] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID]
FROM [GBVDetails] WHERE DELETED = 0 AND GBVDetailID = @GBVDetailID

operation.name: DeleteGBVDetail
operation.query:
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT GBVMainID FROM [GBVDetails] WHERE Deleted = 0 AND GBVDetailID = @GBVDetailID )) SET @ReturnValue = 0 ELSE BEGIN
UPDATE [GBVDetails] SET [LastModificationTimestamp] = GETDATE() ,[LastModificationUserID] = @UserID ,[Deleted] = 1 WHERE GBVDetailID = @GBVDetailID
SET @ReturnValue = 1
END
